title: Search for wild wolves with an expert
description: Spend a morning with a private wildlife naturalist and powerful spotting scopes. Real suspense, discovery and a wild winter landscape distinguish this from a zoo visit.
teaser: Spend a morning with a private wildlife naturalist and powerful spotting scopes.
goodToKnow: Viewing happens mainly from a vehicle, with optional cold outdoor stops. Wildlife sightings are always unpredictable.
